name.text: Shared: Diagnose decimal places versus significant figures

questiontext.text:
Consider the number \[ {@number_display@}. \]

(a) Round it to {@dp_count@} decimal places.

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]

(b) Round the same number to {@sf_count@} significant figures.

[[input:ans2]] [[validation:ans2]]

[[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

Decimal places are counted from the decimal point.

Significant figures are counted from the first non-zero digit.

For \[ {@number_display@}, \] the answers are:

{@dp_count@} decimal places: \[ {@answer_dp_display@} \]

{@sf_count@} significant figures: \[ {@answer_sf_display@} \]

questiondescription.text:
Shared Curriculum-Independent Question Bank

PVRS-05

number-sense

decimal-places-vs-significant-figures

diagnostic

paired-rounding-diagnostic

Learners round the same number using decimal-place and significant-figure instructions so the two conventions can be distinguished diagnostically.

Targets the belief that decimal places and significant figures are the same rounding instruction.

Original STACK question. Interaction ideas were informed by reference-only Numbas items NUMBAS-21514, NUMBAS-169559 and NUMBAS-21530. No source wording or mathematical content is copied.

None.

Curriculum alignment is maintained outside the question source.

prtpartiallycorrect.text: One part is correct. Compare how decimal places and significant figures are counted.

prtincorrect.text: Decimal places are counted from the decimal point, while significant figures start at the first non-zero digit.

node.description: Decimal-place answer was correct. Checks significant-figure answer.

truefeedback.text: Correct. You distinguished decimal places from significant figures.

falsefeedback.text: Your decimal-place answer is correct. For significant figures, start counting from the first non-zero digit.

node.description: Checks whether the learner used the significant-figure result for the decimal-place part.
Checks for the paired swap misconception.

truefeedback.text:
You appear to have swapped the two rounding rules.

Decimal places are counted from the decimal point. Significant figures are counted from the first non-zero digit.

falsefeedback.text: Recheck how each rounding instruction is counted.

node.description: Generic diagnostic check when part a is incorrect for another reason.

truefeedback.text: Your significant-figure answer is correct. Recheck how decimal places are counted from the decimal point.

qtest.description: Both correct answers should receive full credit.
Swapping decimal-place and significant-figure procedures should receive zero credit.
Correct decimal-place answer with an incorrect significant-figure answer should receive half credit.
